parsed_json.up: Select drug-indication relationships with molecule identifiers, names, MeSH identifiers, MeSH headings, EFO identifiers as indication_curie, EFO terms as indication_label, and max phase for indication. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication. Map EFO identifiers to indication_curie and EFO terms to indication_label. Return rows sorted by chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
